name: budget-guidance-solo
description: Credential-free first-use installation and offline posture/extension contracts from an exact local source snapshot; requires Python 3.10+ and Node.js 20+.
validates: Stamping creates a self-contained payload without provisioning the runtime.
The first binstub use provisions after the original source copy is removed.
Installed source/version identity, unavailable posture, and synthetic static posture are preserved.
The installed snapshot's extension passes candidate-owned SDK fixtures without a live session or credentials.

config.CR_HARNESS_MOUNT: read-only local candidate checkout supplied with --harness-mount
